verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an ELT/data-pipeline product, but the evidence pack documents no data retention policies, purge or deletion commands, or TTL settings. Self-hosting ('host and manage everything on your own servers') and stream/property selection are adjacent features. They limit what gets extracted or where data lives, but they do not control how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
